Fixed 2 bugs for the trim algorithm on ground. First, the algorithm was using the compressed contacts which was leading to incorrect placement once the aircraft was relocated with uncompressed contacts. Second, the order in which the rotations were applied was wrong and that was corrupting the trim solution for tail wheel aircrafts. Unfortunately the error was harmless for tricycle aircrafts which generally have small pitch angles when resting on ground.

Fixed the accelerometer that wrongly summed the gravity twice. It also overlooked the fact that (p,q,r) == (0,0,0) does not mean that (pi,qi,ri) == (0,0,0). As a consequence a centrifugal acceleration exists (albeit small) when (p,q,r) == (0,0,0). Bonus : the formula is now very similar to the acceleration at the pilot location (see FGAuxiliary.cpp)
